velocities_and_objective.scope: Independent FP64 scoring of retained predictions; GPU reduction roundoff reported without a new threshold or backward replay.

checkpoints_and_gradients.scope: FP64 AdamW equations start from each exact 16-update checkpoint and consume all saved post-clip gradients. Residuals at the next checkpoint are descriptive, not a GPU replay or a new acceptance threshold.
checkpoints_and_gradients.safe_loader: weights_only=True with only the installed TorchVersion string subclass allowed for runtime metadata.

limitations: No model or backward pass replay; checks use retained tensors and runtime records.
128 paired updates on one development layout do not establish image quality, command following or generalization.
Different draws/windows prevent interpreting the chronological loss series as measured learning improvement.
Resource bounds are verified at saved sampling instants; external timeout configuration is retained admission metadata.
